description: A memory record expanded in full and then in context. The decay calculation is in the summary block rather than below the body, because it is the difference between 'prefers this' and 'preferred this two years ago' and a reader who stops after three lines still needs it. The context expansion gathers the subject history: `insurance-quotes` holds a live record and an archived predecessor that said something different, which is exactly the history a question about a changed preference needs, and each neighbour keeps its own locator so grouping them costs nobody the ability to expand one. The last two responses are refusals: a signals locator handed to a memory instance is locator_unknown rather than expired, because that record never lived here, and refusing it is what stops one store answering out of the other.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
